description.zh: 通过 SAPSkillhub 自主管理的只读连接和 ADT Data Preview 导出有界的表或 CDS 证据。
description.en: Exports bounded table or CDS evidence through an SAPSkillhub-managed read-only ADT connection.

description.zh: 按生产订单、期间、账本、币种角色和成本要素读取计划、目标与实际成本的只读证据。
description.en: Reads read-only production-order plan, target, and actual cost evidence by period, ledger, currency role, and cost element.

description.zh: 通过两个固定只读 OData 源将 WBS 外部编号解析为唯一控制对象。
description.en: Resolves one WBS external ID to a unique control object through two fixed read-only OData sources.

description.zh: 按财政年度和会计期间读取 WBS 或内部订单的权威剩余承诺；目标来源未验证时关闭。
description.en: Reads authoritative remaining commitments for a WBS or internal order by fiscal year and accounting period; disabled until a target source is validated.
